name: Adjust SDK
plain: A third-party SDK for install attribution, SKAN management, deep links and fraud filtering.
meaning: Collects device IDs, IP, UA, events; supports probabilistic matching on Android and for consenting iOS users. Part of AppLovin.

android.permission: INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE; AD_ID for GAID; Install Referrer library
android.store_policy: Data safety must list SDK data; Families: certified ad SDK rules
android.api_surface: MMP SDK + Play Install Referrer + GAID
android.note: Install Referrer and GAID attribution; Adjust also reads Meta Install Referrer.

ios.permission: NSUserTrackingUsageDescription if IDFA used; privacy manifest from SDK
ios.store_policy: Privacy manifest and signature required for listed SDKs; ATT 5.1.2(i)
ios.note: Wraps SKAN conversion values; ATT status reported through its own consent wrapper.

data.metric: Install, session and event records tied to an MMP ID

fields.name: device ID
fields.range: GAID, IDFA or IDFV, MMP-specific ID

limits.headline: Can link your install to its ad and watch what you do in the app
limits.user_action: Nothing. It starts when the app opens, after you tapped an ad and installed
can: Match an install to an ad through the Play install referrer or ad ID
Collect device IDs, IP address and app events
Guess a match from clues, on Android and for iPhone users who agree
Pass events on to ad networks
cannot: Use the iPhone ad ID after you tap Ask App Not to Track
Guess matches from clues on iPhone without your agreement
Skip the tracking prompt on iPhone
limits.differs: Android uses the install referrer and ad ID. iPhone uses Apple's delayed reports and the ID only if you allow tracking.

story.what_it_is: A third party code library that credits an install to the right ad and fights fake installs.
story.for_you: You never see it. When you install an app after an ad, Adjust helps the app company learn which ad did it, and sends you to the right screen.
story.for_makers: Adjust collects device IDs, IP, user agent and events, and runs attribution, SKAN management, deep links and fraud filters. It supports probabilistic matching on Android and for consenting iOS users. It is part of AppLovin.

use_cases.example: A studio sees which of its 30 ad networks brings the cheapest paying players.
An ad network sends an install click to Adjust and Adjust confirms the match and pays out.
A fashion app uses a deep link to open the right jacket after install.
Adjust flags installs from emulators and click farms so the advertiser does not pay.
A wellness app compares install quality from podcast ads and from social ads.
A growth lead merges ad spend and SKAN data in one dashboard.

risks: Collects IDs and IP across many apps
story.android_note: On Android it reads the Google advertising ID and the Play install referrer.
story.ios_note: On iOS it manages SKAN conversion values and uses the IDFA only if allowed.

technical_bounds: Data flows to the vendor's cloud
Needs ATT for IDFA matching on iOS
Privacy manifest and required reasons apply

legit_uses: Attribution, fraud detection, deep links, ROAS

history.change: MMPs shift to SKAN and consent-gated IDFA for iOS
Privacy manifests and signatures required for the SDK
Privacy Sandbox wind-down: Install Referrer plus GAID remain the Android core
